trajectory_summary: The call opens neutral-cooperative and holds through the quick qualifiers, but stalls hard on bill collection — six-plus minutes of the customer fumbling through a utility app while the rep repeats and escalates the ask instead of pivoting. By the time the rep tries to book, the customer has run out of patience and declines, then surfaces an unresolved contact-frequency complaint on the way out.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag is unknown/unclear; based on the transcript this is a no_appointment — the customer explicitly declined ('not something that I'm interested in doing right now') and the rep never got a day/time.

observed_outcome.quote: That is not something that I'm interested in doing right now.
observed_outcome.reasoning: Customer explicitly declines to be scheduled and cites a family emergency; no day/time or callback commitment was secured by the rep before the call ended.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: Bill was captured ('about a 100') at 02:14 but the rep never reflected it back as a reason to act; the flip should have landed right after capture, e.g. tying her seasonal spike comment to solar savings before pivoting into the document ask.
